deliverables: Cardano title sponsorship of the Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream
Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Dev Gov Day 2026 on July 28, 2026 at ARIA Las Vegas
Free General Admission access for the Cardano community
Complimentary booth space for selected Cardano ecosystem startup projects
Five Cardano-focused main stage panelist positions
Livestream Cardano ads and global livestream participation
Tier 1 media coverage for Cardano ecosystem announcements
Travel and lodging support for 20 Cardano community members
Return of 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury
request.what: Rare Network requests Cardano treasury funding for Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 and Rare Dev Gov Day 2026 in Las Vegas.

claims.claim: Rare Network requests ₳2,750,000, described as $660,000 at a $0.24 ADA valuation, to cover Cardano sponsorship packages for Rare Evo 2026 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026.

The proposal allocates ₳1,166,666.67 for Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026 sponsorship, ₳833,333.33 for Rare Evo 2026 title sponsorship, and ₳750,000 for Intersect, audit, fees, tax withholdings, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.
Rare Network states it will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with the current retail value of a VIP ticket listed as $900.
Rare Evo 2026 will occur regardless of treasury funding, but the proposal says treasury funding would expand Cardano's presence, accessibility, participation, and strategic industry outreach.
Rare Network claims it has operated in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has run Rare Evo annually for five consecutive years.

The proposal reports Rare Evo 2025 metrics including 2,500 annual attendees, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social impressions, and 40+ Cardano projects represented.

The proposal says the first Cardano Dev Gov Day in 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and included a keynote from Charles Hoskinson, governance discussions, technical education, workshops, and community-building activities.

Rare Network states that selected Cardano projects and contributors will receive benefits through open application and qualification processes prioritizing ecosystem contribution, active participation, educational value, and in-person commitment.
The proposal claims existing venue relationships, sponsor networks, production capabilities, volunteer coordination, and industry partnerships reduce execution risk and enable professional scale.

The proposal states alignment with governance, community and ecosystem growth, and ecosystem sustainability pillars by supporting governance programming, free public participation, workshops, booths, travel support, livestream distribution, and media coverage.

summary: The document requests ₳2.75M for Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 and Rare Dev Gov Day 2026, presenting event history, attendance and reach metrics, sponsorship deliverables, a budget breakdown, selection processes for benefits, and a promised 20% VIP ticket-sales return to the treasury.
